name: 12037 · Chatham, NY
findings: ZIP 12037 (Chatham) has 35 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (60%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Community organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 12037 (Chatham) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 12037 (Chatham) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 17% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
